description: Seed Hybridizer Item Level 60 Requires Herbalism (300) Use: Places a Seed Hybridizer that allows seeds to be multiplied or combined into rarer tiers, and provides all of the benefits of an Incense Candle. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over an Incense Candle to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown) Max Stack: 20
